source_text.body:
Dispatch plumbers from tenant maintenance emails
A Zapier Agent for a Milwaukee property manager monitors email for maintenance requests, checks tenant status in AppFolio, and drafts plumber dispatch and tenant confirmation messages.
·
Aug 10, 2026
Done with
ZA
Zapier Agents
What they did
Pfeiffer Digital built a Zapier Agent that watched a Milwaukee property manager's inbox for maintenance requests. For each request it looked up the tenant's status in AppFolio. If the tenant was in good standing, it drafted a dispatch email to the plumber and a confirmation text to the tenant. A staff member only reviewed the drafts and clicked send.
How it went
The source says this saved roughly 15 hours of admin work each week, replacing about 10 minutes of research per request. It gives no further metrics, and the account is a brief anecdote.
Worth knowing
Keep a human approving every send at first, and check the agent's activity logs daily in week one. The source says agents can take unexpected logic paths.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Create an agent that watches [email inbox] for maintenance requests from tenants. For each one, look up the tenant's status in [property management tool], then draft a message to [vendor type, e.g. plumber] with the issue and unit details, and a confirmation message to the tenant. Do not send anything; save the drafts for me to review, and stop once each request has two drafts ready.
Original source: https://pfeifferdigital.com/blog/zapier-agents-for-smb-2026-08-10-c79a2e
